description: Framing, error detection/correction (Hamming, CRC), flow control, sliding window protocols (Go-Back-N, Selective Repeat), ALOHA, CSMA/CD, and IEEE 802.11 (CCN03-CCN04)

questions.question: Why is stop-and-wait inefficient on long-delay links?

The sender wastes time idle during propagation waiting for ACK
It forces the receiver to buffer many out-of-order frames

questions.question: In CSMA/CD, what happens when a collision is detected?
options: The station buffers the frame and retransmits after a fixed delay

questions.question: Binary Exponential Backoff in CSMA/CD is used to:
options: Increase the jam signal duration after each successive collision

Limit the maximum number of retransmission attempts to 2^n
